steps.text: Feist thought he was getting a talking to.
He was ready, thinking about what he could say to move the heart of the stubborn old worker before him.
Catherine has seen too much. Her temper is harder than the machines in the factory.
His cleverness with words has never been of any use before Catherine. Her fierce gaze sees through all, turning his wits to mush.
Feist feels a familiar sense of helplessness.
He always turns back into a little boy before his grandmother. Clumsy, excitable, prone to saying something he instantly regrets. He can only wait for his grandmother to speak first.
But Catherine says nothing.
She leads Feist down a long path. When they finally stop, he glances at her expression, and surprisingly sees no hint of anger.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What's up ahead?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I remember this workshop. You used to come here by yourself. Why is the production line empty, though?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What did you think this place was?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The old workers wouldn't say, but Patto made a bet with Day that it's the secret workshop where they used to build steam armor.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Tell Patto he won the bet.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: So this is really the steam armor... no, I don't understand...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've followed you down this path a few times. I heard... I heard the machines running, and the conveyor belt moving.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: They still run, if someone hits the switch.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Why was it abandoned? Because the Steam Knights disappeared? No, even without orders, these machines are too dear to be left idle.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Why... why indeed?
The aging worker pats the machine, as though she was asking the cold metal.
Feist realizes that all the machines are spotless, with nary a speck of dust on them. It is as though time has stopped in this secret workshop.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Do you know why I'm the only one who came here?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Cam, Mike, Branson... they should have been standing there. And Harvey, he'd be responsible for watching the thrusters.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: When the production line moves as one... I guarantee you've never heard a song quite like it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Harvey... isn't that Dad's name?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Your dad was the smartest worker in the entire city. He came up with all sorts of crazy ideas.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've only seen him in photos.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I wish you could have seen him in the flesh. You're like him... too much so, at times.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Harvey was an expert in steam engines. He was like an engine himself, going so fast that I couldn't keep up.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I should've kept up.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Didn't Dad go missing after getting caught in some business on the streets? That's what you said whenever I asked.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Some business... if what happened twenty-six years ago could be called as much.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Twenty-six years ago? Didn't His Majesty...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Yes. Londinium fell into chaos overnight, the nobles were at each other's throats, and the dukes led the way.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Lots of factories got hit, especially military ones making steam armor. We were forced to stop work.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Harvey... he was young then. Almost the same age as you now. He loved the factory, and he loved this city.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: He left the factory with the other workers to protest against the nobles. He wanted the dukes to hear the voices of the workers, and protect our livelihood.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Naive, wasn't he?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I think back to it, on quiet nights... was it a cold one in December? Was his blood warm when it came out of his chest?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Dad did it... for his ideals.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You want to say how noble it is to sacrifice for your ideals?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The leaders of your Self-Salvation Corps and that 'Doctor' of yours... is that what they say when they mourn their dead friends?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's what Commander Clovisia would say. As for the Doctor... the Doctor is even more quiet than usual at times like those. But I can feel the pure, heartfelt sincerity.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The dead are in no position to appreciate their greatness.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: As for the ones they leave behind... these words of consolation are like cigarette smoke, light and fluffy, comforting for a moment, but when it leaves your lungs...
She takes a breath, a pause, then breathes out again.
The temperature is not low enough to leave a white fog.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Only one thing is for certain. Forty-one workers walked onto the largest street in Central Londinium on that night, twenty-six years ago. None came back.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Nothing changed about the city. The nobles, the wealthy, they pretend nothing happened, but this workshop would never be the same again.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I'm too old to train another group of workers as good as them, Feist.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: They should've taken over for me. Harvey should've been the one to teach you all you knew.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Believe it or not, I've never blamed Harvey, and I've never blamed you.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But think about it carefully. You should've thought about it carefully when you tried to lead Patto and the others into your rebellion.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: If you survive this war, but the others don't, will you be like me, fraught with grief and regret night after night, leaning over machines with no one to use them?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I didn't understand your decision three years ago, Granny.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But now, when I think back to that day, when I try to put myself in your shoes...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It would have taken me a long time to make that decision.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You're right. Being smart isn't enough to fool death.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But compromise and subservience won't get the job done either.
Catherine takes a drag on her cigarette and says nothing.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I can't say I've thought this through.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I can't guarantee we'll be able to drive out the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've been feeling the weight on my shoulders, ever since Rhodes Island told us that we didn't have much time.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm afraid I'll do something stupid again.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I can't stop here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Otherwise, I'll never be able to face Johnny, Gabby, and the Self-Salvation Corps fighters who gave their lives.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Too young... too naive, little brat.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You there, 'Doctor'. You look like you've got a grip on yourself, unlike this boy.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Would you kindly take care of him?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: There's a hidden compartment in the third drawer of my desk.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The Sarkaz are watching closely. There's no place for you here. Read it and get out.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Don't bring trouble to anyone else.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...Thanks, Granny.
You catch a glimpse of Catherine's expression as she passes by you.
Sorrow, and gratification.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's take a look, Doctor.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny's room is over here.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Do you have the goods?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: All here.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: How's Mr. Bader?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: I heard he's ill. Anyway, it's all here. Our business is concluded.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Good. Please pass on my gratitude.
One after another, heavily-armed mercenaries emerge from the warehouse.
Their leader walks towards the Self-Salvation Corps and extends the hand not holding a weapon.
Are you our new employer? I'm Totter.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hello, Totter. Thank you for making the trip.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: The container was a little stuffy.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Not that it's much different out here.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah. Welcome to Londinium.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Team 8, take our new friends to the base. Watch out for Sarkaz patrols.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Yes, ma'am. Come with us.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The scales tip ever so slightly in our favor.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We don't have much time left, Clovisia. They've began culling the nobles.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We've evacuated the ducal residence and moved to Hideout Beta, which is better concealed. It's safe for now, but I'm not sure for how long.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The number of Sarkaz in the city is increasing.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The bulk of their forces will return in three days.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The Nachzehrer King... The terrible corpse eater.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya told me about his powers. He 'eats' war... turning the battlefield into part of himself simply by standing on it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: How do we defeat the battlefield itself?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The dukes' fleets must be united to win.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our soldiers have to avoid him. That's why we need to move before he returns.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: They're living legends.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The Sarkaz Royal Court... if they truly plan to suppress the entire city, over the heads of Lt. Colonel Lettou and the Defense Forces...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You're good at math, Clovisia. What are the chances we triumph over these terrible legends?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Very good then. The Self-Salvation Corps didn't come this far by crunching numbers.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The fighters are doing their best.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Whatever may come, at least our hearts are one, aren't they, Allerdale?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...Huh? Oh, yes, of course.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What are you thinking about?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm thinking... I hope tomorrow goes as well as these past few days have.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't you think they've been going a little too smoothly lately?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's a good thing, innit?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Good things don't happen on their own.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I agree with Vina. You get lucky once, sure, but not every time.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hey, those men have been loitering for a while...
The man on the corner glances at them briefly.
He should not have been able to see so deep into the alley. But he suddenly pulls back his gaze, and briskly walks away with his head lowered.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Tell Allerdale... tell the Corps to evacuate the warehouse district immediately!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Yes, Siege.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They want to know why.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We are being watched... no time to explain.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda, Indra, Morgan. Proceed with the plan.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is everyone out?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Run now. Talk later.
